caption: The drawing depicts a wrought iron gate in front of a classical building with a triangular pediment. The gate consists of two symmetrical panels, each featuring a diamond lattice pattern in the lower section and a series of elongated, vertical, oval shapes above, connected with small floral details. The panels are framed by vertical bars, and there are visible hinges and latches at the center where the doors would open. Above the center of the gate, a decorative iron finial rises in an ornate cross-like pattern with scrollwork and a semicircular fan design at the base. In the upper left of the drawing, there is a rosette or floral ornament. The color palette is monochromatic, rendered in shades of light brown and beige, giving the drawing a sepia-toned appearance. The background features architectural elements in light wash, indicating a building façade behind the gate.
title: Cast and Wrought Iron Fence
